I am leaving this one-star review not to make a definitive claim, but to share a serious unresolved concern regarding my dining experience at Feast Restaurant – Sheraton Nha Trang.
After dining at the restaurant, I experienced stomach pain and digestive discomfort. While I cannot confirm that the food was the direct cause, the symptoms occurred shortly after the meal, which raised understandable concerns for me as a guest.
I reported this matter directly to the property, hoping for a professional follow-up, clarification, or reassurance regarding food safety standards. Unfortunately, I received no response at all, which left my concern completely unresolved.
The one-star rating reflects the lack of communication, accountability, and service recovery, rather than a confirmed food-related incident. For a hotel operating under an international brand, ignoring a guest’s health-related concern is deeply disappointing.
I hope management will take this feedback seriously, improve internal follow-up procedures, and handle similar situations with greater care and responsibility in the future.
